diagnostics.objective: unpenalized mean negative log likelihood in original time units

generation.algorithm: continuous exponential events with dropout after each repeat purchase

metadata.likelihood_convention: One ordered continuous event history, without time/factorial count normalization. Frequency excludes the initial purchase. All customers start active; x=0 implies probability_active=1. Fixed log_likelihood is per history; weight multiplies only the fit total.
metadata.mean_convention: expected_purchases is conditional on history and averages over activity. expected_if_active = expected_purchases / probability_active.

model_source.title: "Counting Your Customers" the Easy Way: An Alternative to the Pareto/NBD Model

metadata.numerical_note: All expected values call the unmodified package.
metadata.probability_convention: Active at the observation endpoint, after any purchase-triggered dropout.

tolerances.justification: Fixed values use moderate finite inputs. MLE checks allow optimizer stopping differences; the total objective and independently differenced gradient must also agree.
